settings.title: More than
settings.intro: We're a full-service accounting firm, but we keep it simple: you get one team that knows your business, your numbers, and your goals — and that's it.

features.title: Clean monthly books
features.text: We reconcile, categorize, and close your books every month, so you always know exactly where your money is — and where it's going.

features.title: Tax strategy year-round
features.text: We plan deductions and entity structure across the year, not in a panic in March, so you keep more of what you earn.

features.title: Payroll that just works
features.text: We run payroll, file the returns, and handle new hires and terminations — so your team gets paid right and on time, every time.

features.title: Cash-flow clarity
features.text: We turn your numbers into a forward-looking cash-flow picture, so you can decide when to hire, invest, or hold.

features.title: Advisory that pays for itself
features.text: We sit with you quarterly to review the numbers and the decisions behind them — pricing, margins, and growth — and it usually pays for itself.

features.title: One point of contact
features.text: You get a dedicated team that knows your file, not a call center. Ask a question and get an answer from someone who knows your business.
features.detail: A team that knows your name

settings.title: One firm,
settings.intro: From day-to-day bookkeeping to year-end tax and long-term strategy, Ledger & Leaf covers the full accounting lifecycle for growing businesses.

design.title: Monthly bookkeeping
design.text: Bank feeds, reconciliations, and clean category coding delivered as a tidy monthly close you can actually read.

design.title: Financial statements
design.text: Clear P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements prepared to a standard your bank and investors will trust.

build.title: Business & personal tax
build.text: Corporations, partnerships, LLCs, and individuals — prepared accurately and filed on time, with planning built in.

build.title: Entity & structure advice
build.text: The right entity for where you are now and where you're going, so you don't pay more tax than you have to.

launch.title: Payroll services
launch.text: Full-service payroll with direct deposit, tax filings, and year-end W-2s and 1099s handled end to end.

launch.title: CFO-style advisory
launch.text: Quarterly reviews of margins, pricing, and cash flow that help you make confident decisions about growth.

settings.title: From messy inbox
settings.intro: A simple, predictable onboarding that gets your numbers clean and keeps them that way.

steps.title: Onboard
steps.text: We connect your bank and accounting software, gather your current records, and get a clear picture of where your books stand today.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.text: We reconcile past months, fix the categories, and close out any gaps so you start from a clean, accurate baseline.

steps.title: Automate
steps.text: We set up bank feeds, recurring entries, and a monthly close routine so the books stay current without you chasing receipts.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: You get a clear monthly close and a quarterly strategy call where we walk through the numbers and the decisions behind them.

steps.title: Advise
steps.text: We keep planning tax, payroll, and cash flow year-round, so you're never surprised at year-end and never overpay.

settings.note: Most of our clients say the same thing after the first quarter: they finally understand their own numbers — and they sleep better at tax time.

settings.title: Straight answers,
settings.intro: The questions business owners ask us most before they hand over the books.

items.question: How is this different from doing it myself in QuickBooks?
items.answer: Software records transactions; we make sure they're right, complete, and meaningful. We reconcile, categorize, close monthly, and turn the numbers into decisions — that's the part software can't do.

items.question: Do you work with my existing software?
items.answer: Almost certainly. We work in QuickBooks, Xero, and most major platforms, and we'll connect to whatever you already use so you don't have to switch.

items.question: What does onboarding look like?
items.answer: We connect your accounts, review your current records, clean up any gaps, and set up a monthly close routine. Most businesses are fully onboarded within two to three weeks.

items.question: How do you charge?
items.answer: A flat monthly fee based on the size and complexity of your business — no surprise hourly bills. You'll know exactly what you pay and what you get.

items.question: Are you available year-round, or just at tax time?
items.answer: Year-round. We're your bookkeeper, tax planner, and advisor all year, not a seasonal filing service. That's how we keep your numbers clean and your taxes low.
